answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the sable release is entered with every signature, the mesa audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the signal graph and each risks its bond. The fee repeats 27 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
